Author: Glamour Pact contributors
Name: Glamour Pact
Punchline: Dom-controlled looks, local Synced Mods and opt-in strict controls.
Description: An opt-in Dom/Sub outfit library with named outfits, copyable macros, configurable glam locks, local Synced Looks and Customize+ profile/template choices. Shared Customize+ profiles require separate consent. Automatic styling pauses safely during transfers; helmet controls never edit weapons. Optional exact-Dom follow, looping pose locks and GPact Offline control; disabling the plugin remains the local exit. Update both players to 0.6.3 for more resilient Offline-lock renewal.
Changelog: Makes Offline-lock renewal independent of the general network queue while preserving control-send order. A transient request failure no longer abandons renewal of a confirmed lock; attempts retain the existing four-second cadence. The Sub lease is bounded at 30 seconds instead of 12, so an unseen disconnect may take up to 30 seconds to release. Observed owner Offline, real world changes, logout, character changes and plugin restart still release the lock; expired locks never silently revive. Adds release-reason reporting. Client-only update: no SeitonSense, Worker, D1 or native-reference changes. Update both players.
